From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACME POC — recap & proposed plan

Thanks again for a great discovery call today — appreciate the clarity on ACME's goals. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

Scope (what we'll evaluate in the POC)
- Real-time inference for product search/autocomplete (text-in -> tokens -> top-k suggestions)
- Throughput and latency under typical query patterns (60 QPS sustained, short tail up to 200 QPS)
- Quality check vs current rules-based baseline on the provided sample set

Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for requests up to ~512 tokens
- Quality: >10% uplift in top-3 relevance metric on the supplied eval set vs baseline
- Cost: projected per-1000-query cost below your internal target of $X (we'll refine once we have token counts)

Proposed timeline (3 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): access, infra setup, data ingestion (owner: ACME - Priya)
- Week 1: baseline runs, evaluate quality, iterate prompts/config (owners: Redwood Eng - Marcus, ACME data)
- Week 2: stress/load testing, final metrics, handoff and next-steps decision (owners: Marissa + Ryan)

Owners
- ACME: Priya Singh (data lead), Ryan Carter (product owner)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (account lead), Marcus Lin (engineering lead)

Immediate next steps (action items)
1) ACME to share sample dataset + small eval set (S3 link or secure Drive) by Fri 7/9 — point of contact: Priya
2) ACME security to send SOC2 report or indicate compliance questions — contact: security@acme.com
3) Redwood to provision sandbox + share test endpoints and setup checklist (attached) by Fri 7/9

Attachments: redwood-poc-setup-checklist.xlsx (setup checklist), sow-draft-acme-v1.pdf (initial SOW for review)

If that all looks right I’ll schedule a 30-min alignment call for Wed 7/14 to review progress.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
